description: Reserve horizontal padding on both sides of inline code spans in components/layout/text.coax and components/kit/markdown.coax.

steps.send: In `components/layout/text.coax` and `components/kit/markdown.coax`: reserve horizontal padding on both the leading and trailing sides of inline code spans during line measurement and painting so inline code pill backgrounds never overlap neighboring text. Add/update `#test` checks and verify with `coax/bin/coax test components/layout/text.coax && coax/bin/coax test components/kit/markdown.coax`.

graders.run: awk '/^text_run_width ::/,/^}/' components/layout/text.coax | grep -q code_pad && coax/bin/coax test components/layout/text.coax && coax/bin/coax test components/kit/markdown.coax
